prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1169; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and limited range of motion. Clinical evaluation found reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, which are consistent with the reported mechanism of injury, while neurological screening and imaging-related assessments were within normal limits. The reported injury is a plausible outcome of a collision of this type. No prior injury to the cervical region is documented in the available history. Care was delivered over 22 visits and consisted of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate entries. At the time of discharge the patient reported mild residual stiffness and was instructed to continue a home exercise program as needed.
